rows.label: Books and magazines rest, somehow untouched by time, in cardboard boxes.
A dog collar lies discarded and stained. Once, it was pink.
An old poster of a flopped blockbuster movie stands rolled against the wall.
An empty pizza box leans upright against the wall.
A pile of dusty wood debris rests forgotten in the corner.
Green, brown, and white stains spread across a threadbare carpet.
A mannequin head, scribbled over in marker, lies face-up.
A headless plus-size mannequin slumps against the wall, one arm raised.
The cover of an old gossip magazine announces the union of two celebrities who broke up last year.
Dew-like droplets cling to the spiral threads of a spiderweb.
Medicine boxes spill out of a soil-streaked plastic bag.
A red flashlight with leaking batteries lies forgotten.
Pieces of a cup shaped like a cartoon character rest broken.
Something small scuttles across the floor, then vanishes.
Rust gathers thick around every lock.
A centipede disappears into a crack in the wall.
A dried frog carcass clings to the base of a wall.
A vinyl cover lies under a rock, the disc nowhere to be seen.
Dark water forms a shallow puddle.
Collapsed ceiling lies on the floor, under a hole of the same size.
Time has peeled away the paint from most of every wall.
Spiderwebs and dust cover an outdated socket near the floor.
Old newspapers covered in nonsensical writings hang on the wall.
A sad, tortured confession has been written on the wall.
A shoebox is filled with floppy disks and expired medicine.
A half-smoked joint lies forgotten in a wall crack, almost fossilized.
An old black-and-white photo of a child lies on the floor, the face faded by time.
An empty peanut butter jar has been forgotten next to a luxury-brand condom packet.
An uncommon and mildly controversial pop culture take has been sprayed on the wall.
A rusty stop sign lies on the floor beside a PS2 game case.
An artistic graffiti of an anime character adorns the wall.
A rusty, dusty ladder rests against the wall, its paint withering away.
A dusty porcelain cat poses, one ear broken.
A bent, wheel-less bicycle is covered in dusty spiderwebs.
A whole beer pack has been forgotten, cans expired a decade ago.
A red warning has been sprayed on a distant wall: unstable floor be safe 1/1/2011.
A collection of bizarre handmade jugs is preserved inside a wooden box.
Lampshades with no coverings are grouped in a corner.
A moldy red ball gag lies beside torn stockings.
An old rusty coin has been forgotten in an ashtray.
Wooden beams pile up on a floor covered in graffiti.
A graffiti signature in red covers one in white.
A broken black umbrella rests in a small pink cradle.
A grimy pink blender lies on the ground, the base detached from its broken body.
Three big glass panels are piled up, the edges chipped away.
Wiry vines crawl out of cracks in the concrete.
A binder with study notes has been left here.
A yellowed newspaper scrap on the floor mentions a country that no longer exists.
Fuck the ploice says graffiti on the wall.
A gumball machine lies fallen on the ground, still almost full.
